Sidious''', [[Reproduction|born]] '''Sheev Palpatine''' and also simply known as the '''Emperor''', was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], with his [[Imperial Era|reign]] lasting from [[19 BBY]] to [[4 ABY]]. Rising to power in the [[Galactic Senate]] as the [[senator]] of [[Naboo]], the secretive [[Sith Lord]] cultivated two identities, Sidious and Palpatine, using both to further his [[Politics|political]] career and deceive his way into [[Grand Plan|accomplishing his goal]]. He orchestrated the fall of the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order]] through the [[Clone Wars]], and then [[Proclamation of the New Order|established]] his reign over [[the galaxy]] which lasted until his [[death]] at the [[Battle of Endor]]. However, the [[dark side of the Force]] gave rise to [[Transference|powers]] which allowed him to [[Resurrection|escape death]], seeking further [[immortality]] until the Emperor was eventually permanently destroyed and killed during the [[Battle of Exegol]] by [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], his granddaughter born from his [[Strand-Cast]] clone [[Youngling|son]] [[Dathan]] and his daughter-in-law [[Miramir]]. Born on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] Naboo in [[84 BBY]] as the [[High Republic Era]] ended, Sheev Palpatine possessed a strong connection to [[the Force]], and was secretly trained in the ways of the [[Sith]] by [[Darth Plagueis]] with Palpatine taking Darth Sidious as his Sith persona. He eventually betrayed and killed his [[Sith Master]], in order to train his own [[Sith apprentice]], [[Darth]] [[Maul]], for the [[Rule of Two]] limited their ranks to two Sith [[Lord]]s at any given [[time]]. The [[Invasion of Naboo]], a crisis orchestrated by Sidious, led to the Senate to [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY|elect]] Palpatine as [[Supreme Chancellor]], although this came at the loss of Maul, who was defeated and presumed killed in the [[Battle of Naboo]]. The [[Separatist Crisis]] and the Clone Wars were masterminded by Sidious and his second apprentice, [[Dooku|Darth Tyranus]], in an effort to achieve [[Galaxy|galactic]] dominance. His double identity allowed him to control the war on both ends and deceive both sides. Following an attempt to [[Duel in Palpatine's office|arrest the chancellor]], the [[Great Jedi Purge]] commenced with Sidious enacting [[Order 66]]. With the [[Jedi]] all but extinct, Sidious installed the [[New Order]] in the Republic's [[Republic Era|place]], declaring himself Galactic [[Emperor]] and bringing an end to the [[Millennium|millennia]] of [[democracy]]. [[Battle of Coruscant|Shortly after betraying and causing the death of Tyranus]], he took on a new apprentice, having lured the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] to the dark side and transforming him into Darth Vader. Their reign was virtually unchallenged for a generation until the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War]], the Emperor sought to betray Vader, by replacing him with the latter's son, [[Luke Skywalker]]. However, Sidious' plan backfired when Vader ultimately renounced the dark side and killed Sidious to protect Luke. Thus, with the Sith's destruction, the Force was brought back into balance, fulfilling Anakin's [[destiny]] as the prophesied [[Chosen One]]. Through his master's teachings, however, Sidious transferred his essence to an imperfect [[Cloning|clone]] vessel that had been [[Clone template|modeled]] on his original body. Anticipating the possibility of defeat, he created the [[Contingency]] to [[Battle of Jakku|destroy]] the Galactic Empire and replace it with a new [[Sith Empire]], in the event of such a setback. His plans culminated in the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[New Republic]] and the [[First Order-Resistance War|emergence]] of the [[First Order]], the creation of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]], who turned [[Ben Solo]]—heir to the [[Skywalker family|Skywalker bloodline]]—to the dark side, and the establishment of the [[Final Order]]. When the Emperor [[Exegol Broadcast|announced]] his return to the galaxy in [[35 ABY]], the [[Resistance]] invaded the planet [[Exegol]], Sidious' [[Sith Citadel|hidden stronghold]] in the [[Unknown Regions]]. During the battle, the resurrected Emperor discovered a [[Force dyad|dyad in the Force]] in the form of the [[Force-bond|bond]] between Solo and Rey, a [[Padawan]] sired from the [[Palpatine family|Palpatine bloodline]]. His lifelong dream of eternal rule was finally quashed when Rey called upon the strength of past Jedi to vanquish her grandfather by turning his own [[Force lightning|power]] against him, destroying Sidious and his [[Sith Eternal]] [[Sith cultist|cultists]].
